hero_subheadline: Fast, reliable, and affordable plumbing services for homes and businesses. Available 24/7 for emergencies.
about_text: With over 15 years of experience serving the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex, Demo Plumbing Co has built a reputation for excellence, integrity, and unmatched craftsmanship.
about_text_2: Our team of licensed plumbers is committed to providing honest assessments, transparent pricing, and lasting solutions. We treat every home like our own.
meta_description: Demo Plumbing Co offers professional plumbing services in Dallas, TX. 24/7 emergency service, licensed & insured. Call (214) 555-0199.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing
services.description: 24/7 emergency repairs for burst pipes, severe leaks, and plumbing disasters.

services.title: Fixture Installation
services.description: Professional installation of sinks, faucets, toilets, showers, and bathtubs.

services.title: Water Heater Service
services.description: Repair and installation of tank and tankless water heaters for homes and businesses.

services.title: Camera Inspection
services.description: State-of-the-art camera inspections to diagnose hidden pipe problems.

testimonials.text: Demo Plumbing saved us during a midnight pipe burst. They arrived in 30 minutes and had it fixed within an hour. Incredible service!

testimonials.text: We use Demo for all our commercial plumbing needs. Fair pricing, professional team, and they always clean up after. Highly recommend.
